description: An attribute access after a legacy index in an attribute-only splat applies to each element
notes: The spec's grammar lets an attribute-only splat consume only attribute accesses (attrSplat = "." "*" GetAttr*) and says a legacy index is an index operation, not an attribute access, so .0 and everything after it would apply to the splat's result, and .b on the tuple that .0 selects would be an error. hashicorp/hcl deliberately includes legacy indexes in an attribute-only splat and keeps reading attribute accesses after them (parseExpressionTraversals in hclsyntax/parser.go).
